title: Add SDK compatibility policy
summary: Distribution readiness still lists SDK stability as planned even though workspace packages already expose typed surfaces. Add a machine-readable SDK compatibility report and policy that distinguishes workspace-alpha SDK evidence from public npm stability.
expectedFailureModes: SDK packages drift without a documented compatibility boundary or export-map check.
Distribution readiness implies public SDK stability before npm publication and protocol binding fixtures exist.
Package metadata changes break consumers because workspace-alpha and public-stable surfaces are not separated.
nextAction: Add SDK compatibility documentation, a report/validator over package metadata and export maps, and update distribution readiness/status without claiming public SDK publication.
